summary: The proposed gate sup_b ||p_(Q3|Q'=b)||_infinity<=C is false even for four iid Uniform[0,1] coordinates and A=A3+(1/128)ee^T with spectrum {1,1,-1,1/128}. If S=sum Xi and Q'=(1/512)S^2, then for 0<s<1, ||p_(Q3|S=s)||_infinity>=2/(3s^2), so the scalar conditional supremum is infinite. This does not refute QFORM: retaining the actual scalar-fiber probability weights gives an explicit weighted envelope <29 for the same instance. The repaired interface is QFORM-WEIGHTED-SCALAR-CURVED-FIBER-v1; the global weighted-envelope bound remains open.
scope: Refutes only the unweighted scalar conditional supremum proof interface; the full arbitrary independent-input quadratic-form conjecture remains open.
